reason: A chat-composer utility that uses the host language model to rewrite draft prompts for clarity and executability, then lets the user review and replace the draft.

summaries.zh: 在聊天输入框中调用宿主语言模型优化草稿提示词，并支持预览后将改写结果写回输入框。
summaries.en: Optimizes draft prompts in the chat composer with the host language model and lets users review and replace the draft with the rewrite.

capabilities: Reads the current chat composer text when activated
Sends the draft to the host language model for rewriting
Writes the selected rewrite back into the chat composer
